spans.s: वृद्धिनिमित्त lit. cause of Vrddhi (वृद्धेर्नि- मित्तम्) such as the employment of the indicatory letter ञ् or ण् in an affix or the lettter क् in tad.affixes; the term is, however, found used in the sense of having in it a cause of Vrddhi, i.e. an indicatory letter ञ्, ण् or क्.; cf वृद्धिनिमित्तस्य च तद्धितस्यारक्तविकारे
. cf. वृद्धेर्निमित्तं यस्मिन्स वृद्धिनिमित्त: M. Bh. on P. I. I.
वृद्धिपाद name given to the first pada of Panini's Astadhyayi by gramm- arians, as the beginning of the pada is made by the Sutra वृद्धिरादैच्.
